policy: Twelve distinct, primary-source-checked U.S. events for February 2011. Day and country are reviewed; mapped coordinates are approximate venue, city, or regional markers as disclosed per event. Existing identities and media keys are retained for matching catalog events. New entries do not imply available, licensed, or same-day media. This country-month backfill does not claim all countries or all months meet their targets.
